standard_prerequisites: Delivered card X2-alg-groupoids-quotients-set-theoretic-pre-equivalence-geometric (Lemma lemma-set-theoretic-pre-equivalence-geometric): the three-fold geometric criterion for j to be a set-theoretic pre-equivalence relation, including the containment of the images of the induced maps
Chapter Definition definition-set-theoretic-equivalence, included as a context span below: a set-theoretic equivalence relation is a universally injective set-theoretic pre-equivalence relation
Morphisms of Spaces, Lemma spaces-morphisms-lemma-universally-injective: universal injectivity can be tested by injectivity of the maps on k-valued points over algebraically closed fields

More on Morphisms of Spaces, Lemma spaces-more-morphisms-lemma-when-universally-injective-radicial: a universally injective morphism that is decent, or locally separated, or quasi-separated is radicial
Radicial morphisms: the fibres are spectra of purely inseparable field extensions, so over an algebraically closed field the reduction of a nonempty fibre is the spectrum of the base field itself
core_obligations: The implications (1) implies (2) and (2) implies (3) follow from the delivered pre-equivalence criterion together with the definitions; the same lemma shows (3) makes j a set-theoretic pre-equivalence relation
(3) implies j is universally injective by the k-point test for universal injectivity, so j is a set-theoretic equivalence relation; at this point (1), (2), (3) are all equivalent

(4) implies (3) without hypotheses on j; conversely assume j decent, or locally separated, or quasi-separated, and let k be algebraically closed over B with u-bar sim-R u-bar-prime; the fibre product of R over j with Spec of k at the pair is nonempty

By the radiciality lemma j is radicial, so the reduction of that fibre product is the spectrum of a field purely inseparable over k; since k is algebraically closed it is the spectrum of k, giving a k-valued point r-bar of R with t(r-bar) = u-bar and s(r-bar) = u-bar-prime; hence (4) holds
proof_roadmap: Bootstrap from the delivered pre-equivalence criterion to equivalence of the first three conditions
Close the cycle with the k-point test for universal injectivity
Prove the refinement (4) under the decency hypotheses via radiciality and the purely inseparable fibre
